title: Glowing alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcc33' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcc33' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- bells -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='22' r='10' fill='#ff8844'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='22' r='6' fill='#ffbb66'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='22' r='10' fill='#ff8844'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='22' r='6' fill='#ffbb66'/>
  <!-- hammer -->
  <rect x='46' y='10' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='4' fill='#ffee88'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='80' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#c75f2e'/>
  <rect x='68' y='80' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#c75f2e'/>
  <!-- body rim -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='36' fill='#e86a33'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='36' fill='none' stroke='#ffa766' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='29' fill='#1a1440'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='29' fill='none' stroke='#3a2f7a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <rect x='49' y='26' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <rect x='49' y='73' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <rect x='23' y='51' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <rect x='72' y='51' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x='49' y='34' width='3' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#ffee88'/>
  <rect x='49' y='51' width='15' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#ffee88'/>
  <!-- little smile? no, keep it clean clock -->
</svg>
